glyphs.notes: Rotate the original handwritten question mark 180 degrees around the advance center, translate it +3 x / -12 y font units, then move the dot another -8 y units. This preserves the source outline and advance while improving cap-line position and dot-to-stroke spacing.

glyphs.unicode_name: LATIN CAPITAL LETTER C WITH CEDILLA
glyphs.notes: Keep the original C unchanged. The source lacks U+00B8 and U+00E7, so use only the lower handwritten tail of the source semicolon, scale it 116% horizontally and 82% vertically, rotate it -7 degrees, and place it at an optical center below C with a 26-unit gap. The source comma, J, j, g, and y are retained as style references.

Share the reviewed U+00B8 cedilla outline by identity component reference, set advance width to zero, classify the glyph as a GDEF mark, and attach it to C through the existing GPOS mark feature. The <221 91> base anchor and <95 91> mark anchor reproduce Ccedilla's +126 x / 0 y component placement and 26-unit gap.
